list.name: triple sentences
list.word: This song is a strain on my throat.
The strong man split the log.
I will stroke the cat three times.
The sprinter ran up the street.
This game has a split screen.
My pants have shrunk and split.
I felt a thrill as I sat on the throne.
A thrush will sing in the spring.
I will thrash him in the sprint race.
I will splat you if you splash me.
I got a shrimp in my string net.
You must be strong to play in the scrum.
I was splashed by the spray.
